label: Filter bar
description: A row of field filters plus a search box above a data table. Each listed field becomes a filter chip with type-appropriate operators (is, is not, before, after, is empty). Search uses Postgres full-text search over the entity's text fields. Filters and search narrow the data table in the same column or tab.
usage: List the 3–6 fields people filter by most (status, priority, assignment group, assignee).
Keep showSearch on for lists of records people know by title or number.
Place it directly above the data table, after collection.saved_views.
constraints: Must share a column or tab with a collection.data_table; it filters that table.
fields: at most 8 unique keys of the table's entity; rich_text and long_text cannot be filters.
Results, counts, and filter options are permission-aware: only readable records and values are matched or offered.

binding.description: Adds filter and full-text conditions to the sibling data table's query.

accessibility.keyboard: / focuses search; Tab moves between chips; Enter opens a chip's editor; Backspace in an empty search removes the last chip; Esc clears the search.
accessibility.notes: Result counts are announced in a polite live region after each change.

responsive: Below 720px the chips collapse into a Filters button that opens a sheet; search stays visible.
